scripts.build: bun run build:frontend && bun run build:backend
scripts.check: bun run --cwd frontend lint && bun run --cwd frontend test && bun run build:frontend && cargo check --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:acceptance: bun run acceptance:fixture && bunx playwright test e2e/application-flow.acceptance.spec.ts --config playwright.acceptance.config.ts --retries=0
scripts.test:e2e:video-load: bun run acceptance:fixture && bunx playwright test e2e/video-import.spec.ts e2e/subtitle-sibling-import.spec.ts --retries=0
scripts.test:e2e: bun run e2e:fixture && bunx playwright test
